characterList.description: A person with dark skin tone wearing a bracelet on both hands and a ring on the left hand index finger.
characterList.name: Teacher

content_metadata.description: A tutorial video on constructing a series electrical circuit, explaining its components, assembly, and characteristics.

qAndA.question: What color are the wires connecting the battery holder to the first and third bulb holder?
What happens to the brightness of the bulbs as you move further away from the battery holder in the series circuit?

qAndA.answer: To demonstrate that in a series circuit, a break at any point will stop the entire circuit from functioning.
qAndA.question: Why does the teacher remove one of the bulbs from the circuit?

qAndA.answer: A series circuit relies on continuous connection, and if one component fails, the entire circuit breaks down.
qAndA.question: What is the main takeaway about series circuits from this video?

qAndA.answer: Because if one appliance fails in a series circuit, all other appliances on the same circuit will also fail. This is inconvenient and potentially dangerous.
qAndA.question: Why are series circuits not typically used in homes?

activities.description: The teacher introduces the video tutorial on series circuits.
The teacher lists the materials needed for the experiment: bulbs with bulb holders, connecting wires, a battery holder, batteries, and a screwdriver.

mood.description: Curious - The introduction of a new topic related to electricity sparks curiosity.

narrativeProgression.description: The teacher sets the stage by introducing the topic and outlining the materials needed.

props.name: Three bulbs with blue bulb holders, two Duracell AA batteries, a white battery holder with a red and a green wire attached, a screwdriver with an orange handle, a cotton swab, and several red, blue and green wires with alligator clips on both ends.

scenes.thematicElements: The video focuses on basic principles of electricity and circuit construction.
scenes.title: Introduction and Materials

videoEditingDetails.description: Title card with text 'Make a Series Electrical Circuit' and 'Brought to you by: Gyan Lab'.
Text overlay 'gyan lab' in the bottom right corner throughout the scene.

activities.description: The teacher explains the concept of a series circuit.
The teacher demonstrates connecting the positive end of the battery holder to the first bulb holder.
The teacher connects the first bulb holder to the second using a connecting wire.
The teacher repeats the process, connecting the second bulb holder to the third.
The teacher completes the circuit by connecting the negative end of the battery holder to the third bulb holder.
The teacher inserts the batteries into the battery holder.

mood.description: Focused - The teacher's detailed explanation and demonstration contribute to a focused mood.

narrativeProgression.description: Connection of the positive terminal to the first bulb holder.
Connection between the first and second bulb holders.
Connection between the second and third bulb holders.
Completion of the circuit by connecting the negative terminal to the third bulb holder.
Insertion of batteries and activation of the circuit.

props.name: Same as in Scene 1, but now being used to construct the circuit.

scenes.thematicElements: The video emphasizes the practical application of series circuit principles.
scenes.title: Building the Series Circuit

videoEditingDetails.description: Text overlay 'www.addongyan.com' in the bottom right corner throughout the scene.

activities.description: The teacher observes all three bulbs glowing with varying brightness.
The teacher removes one bulb from the circuit.
The teacher observes all bulbs stop glowing.
The teacher reconnects the bulb, restoring the circuit.
The teacher discusses the implication of the demonstration and asks viewers to think about why series circuits are not used in homes.

mood.description: Inquisitive - The demonstration of the circuit's behavior and the concluding question prompt viewers to analyze and contemplate.

narrativeProgression.description: Observation of varying brightness levels in the bulbs.
Removal of a bulb from the circuit.
Observation of all bulbs ceasing to function.
Reconnection of the bulb and restoration of the circuit.
The teacher challenges viewers to understand the practical limitations of series circuits.

props.name: Same as in Scene 2, with one bulb being temporarily removed and reconnected.

scenes.thematicElements: The video highlights the importance of circuit continuity in series connections.
scenes.title: Demonstrating Series Circuit Properties

videoEditingDetails.description: Text overlay 'www.addongyan.com' in the bottom right corner throughout the scene.

climax.description: The climax occurs when the batteries are inserted into the holder and all the bulbs light up, revealing the successfully constructed series circuit.

storylines.description: Building and Understanding a Series Circuit

youtube_description: Have you seen twinkling lights at Diwali or Christmas? They are small bulbs, all in one line. They use the principle of Series Circuit where all the bulbs are placed in a series or line, hence Series Circuit. Today, we are making our own Series Circuit. Learn and Enjoy!
